usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products, and Qr Code Generator makes a code for each through “Create Simple QR Code”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Simple QR Code” in Qr Code Generator
bestTemplate.why: The code encodes text and a URL, such as a link to the new product.

watchOut: “Create QR Code with Colors” also encodes text and a URL, so pick the style before you run it.
